content:
Today we're making Tau Ceti public. Tau Ceti is a library of formal mathematics, controlled by human-written/reviewed roadmaps, and implemented via AI-driven pull requests and adversarial reviews based on open rubrics. It intends to scale quickly. Tau Ceti lives downstream of Mathlib, and will follow any design decisions Mathlib makes, refactoring as needed.

I'm not going to say much more in this announcement. Please see the #Tau Ceti channel (where preparations have been underway for the last month), and in particular the topics:

  • #Tau Ceti > Welcome to Tau Ceti!
  • #Tau Ceti > Getting started: making a PR
  • #Tau Ceti > Getting started: roadmaps
  • #Tau Ceti > Getting started: reviewing
  • #Tau Ceti > Getting started: the tauceti CLI
  • #Tau Ceti > Getting started: reviewing current content

Hopefully a lot of questions are already answered there. This is an ambitious experimental project, and I'm looking forward to getting everyone's feedback and input on how it should work! I'm also looking forward to PRs creating new roadmaps, reviews of existing roadmap PRs, and participants who want to drive AIs making new contributions and also to help run the PR review process.

Discussion should take place in the Tau Ceti channel.
